subject: What one newsletter record contains
body:
A record carries the publication, the article URL, the published date, the entities extracted from the issue, and any sponsor placement with the evidence line that proves it.

Derived records travel without restriction. Republishing an issue body depends on that publisher's terms, so text is a licensing conversation rather than a default.

For a graph the derived layer is usually the useful half. I can send it mapped against your ontology first.
